Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.compat.gecko

Class GeoBones

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.compat.gecko.GeoBones
public final class GeoBones extends Object
GeckoLib bone access — the GeckoLib analog of vanilla part resolution. Only loaded when GeckoLib is present (reached through GeckoCompat); it references GeckoLib types directly.

Bones are named in the .geo.json, so enumeration yields real names (better than the vanilla reflection family's #N). There is deliberately no "move the pose to a bone" here: a GeckoLib layer can only draw at a bone from inside GooglyGeoLayer.renderForBone(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, T, software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.GeoBone, net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer, float, int, int, int), where GeckoLib hands it the fully-composed pose — re-walking bone transforms outside the model render misses the entity's body rotations (see GooglyGeoLayer). So lookup returns the GeoBone itself, matched by identity at render time.

The adapter requires BakedGeoModel.topLevelBones(), GeoBone.getName(), and GeoBone.getChildBones(); those methods are its complete GeckoLib bone-enumeration boundary.

    • findBone

      @Nullable public static software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.GeoBone findBone(software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.BakedGeoModel model, String token)
      First bone (depth-first, so a stable order) whose root→bone name path suffix-matches token per EyeAttachmentResolver.pathMatches(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), or null. A bare bone name matches like BakedGeoModel.getBone(java.lang.String); a slash path disambiguates same-named bones under different parents, keeping GeckoLib tokens in the same vocabulary as the vanilla resolvers.
